Detailed Description

This is the header file which defines the basis_t type/class. Version 2 of this is more simplistic than the class-based older version.

Used to calculate the barycentric coordinates with a d-simplex as polygon.

This function converts an input point, point_in, from cartesian coordinates to barycentric coordinates based on an input simplex in simp_in.

double basis_term_integral_simplex ( long int  dim_in,
long int *  exp_in 
)

A very very nice function for integrating single polynomial terms over simplices.

I love this function. This function does dimension-generalized (i.e. for any dimension) integration of arbitrary polynomial terms. The dim_in term is the dimension, and the exp_in variable is a pointer to dim_in long integers defining the exponents for each independent variable.
